description: COUNTY LEVEL, FUTURE (next 24 hours to 10 days). AtlasCast Forecast by Address. Use when the question is which storms could affect a county soon. Without a key, returns the exact price quote (count of addresses in the forecast path and price at $0.01/address) and a pay link; with a key it returns the data. County grade and counts by storm type are a paid County Summary (summary=true, $0.02 per county). Input is state plus county. Refreshed 4 times a day. Could happen, not will. Not for past storms (use get_storm_history, get_address_report or get_property_storm_history_report) and not for current weather (use get_current_weather). The paid pull (addresses=true, $0.01 per address) returns one record per address with full_address, lat, lon, county, storm_type, forecast_time and risk_label. For the paid pull, call get_weather_data with dataset=risk and addresses=true (pay with an Atlas United API key, x402, or the card pay link).

api_key.description: Optional. The user's Atlas United API key (tfx_live_...), if they share it in chat. Otherwise leave empty.

county.description: County name without the word 'County', e.g. Dallas.

peril.description: Narrows the forecast to one storm type (e.g. HAIL, WIND, TORNADO, FLASH_FLOOD).

sandbox.description: true = free real data (up to 10 records) at the sandbox place only: 1100 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701 (lat 30.2747, lon -97.7404) or Travis County, TX. Elsewhere it has no effect.

summary.description: true = County Summary: county grade and counts by storm type ($0.02 per county).

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment payload, used instead of an API key.

name: get_risk_forecast
title: AtlasCast Forecast by Address
